messages:
leah: Hi @people-ops — baby arrived early yesterday!
I filed an initial leave notice but I'm missing one hospital form. Can I still enroll my partner on the family plan? Payroll deadline is coming up next week and I'm worried about coverage.

mira (People Ops): Huge congrats, Leah! :tada: You can enroll your partner as a dependent within 30 days of birth. Upload the hospital birth record or state birth certificate when you have it. For payroll cutoff: upload by 2026-09-01 to avoid any interruption; if you miss it we'll do retroactive adjustments but it's extra paperwork.

leah: Thanks. I might not get the official birth cert before the cutoff Is a hospital discharge summary acceptable?

mira (People Ops): Yes — hospital discharge, infant bracelet photo + short note from your provider, or birth verification form are acceptable temporarily. Please mark the upload as "pending certificate" in the portal so Payroll knows to expect the full docs.

harry: From the team side, we need quick coverage for Leah's on-call. Leah, can you DM a short critical-priority list and a handoff time? We'll split rotations.

leah: I'll DM the list tonight and schedule a 30-min handoff for 2026-08-28.

jordan (Payroll): Quick payroll note: if documents arrive after the cutoff we can retro-pay any missed employer contributions, but benefits enrollment changes may show on the next cycle. Uploading the temporary docs and flagging the case number in this thread helps us prioritize.

leah: Got it. Also asked about paid leave weeks on the portal but want to confirm Does Redwood top up short-term disability or is parental pay separate?

mira (People Ops): Good Q. Short-term disability (STD) is managed by the STD carrier for medical leave and may overlap; parental pay is our company benefit and can run concurrently or sequentially depending on your selection when you file. We'll post the exact weeks and payment schedule to your leave case after you complete the portal form.

people-ops-bot: Automated reminder: "Upload temporary docs to HR portal (select 'pending certificate') and include expected return date. Payroll cutoff: 2026-09-01."

harry: I'll draft the on-call rotation and add runbook links. Leah, take care of family first 464338

leah: Thank you all. Uploading discharge summary now and tagging the case. Appreciate the help :heart:
